track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 19: Ozzal
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Ozzal in Homayoun, Shur. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on E3 and dwells most on E in Ozzal. The line peaks at G4 (390.5 Hz) at 0:47.7. It closes on the tonic (E4 → E4 → Fs4 → E4 → G4 → E3).
